_about: The in-app tutorial (Learn). Plain language, second person, short steps. `screens` lists the routes a lesson explains (the '?' button on those screens opens it). `action` is an optional button: {label, href}. Muse may edit freely; keep ids stable (progress is stored per id).

steps.title: Assess, then train what's weak
steps.body: BackForge starts with check-ups: a movement assessment and a posture check. Their results decide your plan — not the calendar.

steps.title: Every day: check in, press Start
steps.body: One tap on the 0–10 pain scale each morning. Today shows how ready you are and one session sized to your time. Press Start and the coach runs it.

steps.title: It adjusts to you
steps.body: Pain and how your form feels decide when moves get harder. Flare days switch to gentle relief automatically — and still count for your streak.

steps.title: Retest every 4 weeks
steps.body: Retests move each area to its next phase when it has improved.

steps.title: Tell the coach your name
steps.body: You → Profile. The coach greets you by name.

steps.title: Tick your equipment
steps.body: Bands (and which strengths), foam roller, kettlebell, door anchor… Plans only use what you have, and work your special kit in.

steps.title: Pick the coach's voice
steps.body: Natural voices are recorded with an open-source neural voice and play offline. Tap Preview to hear one.

steps.title: Optional: a PIN
steps.body: A 4-digit PIN hides the app on this device. It's a privacy screen, not encryption.

steps.title: Three choices, all pre-filled
steps.body: How long, your energy, and any adjustments (standing hurts, a touchy side…). You can just press Start.

steps.title: The player
steps.body: The ring counts down the current step. Back, Play/Pause and Skip sit at the bottom. The timeline shows the whole session — tap it to jump.

steps.title: Easier, +15 s, Pain
steps.body: Easier swaps to the gentler version for the rest of that move. +15 s adds rest. Pain is always on screen: sharp or leg pain stops that move; numbness or weakness stops the session.

steps.title: Rate your form
steps.body: After a corrective move the coach asks how it felt. Clean, shaky or couldn't hold it — that's what moves you up or down.

steps.title: Hands-free
steps.body: Headphone buttons pause and skip. The screen stays on. Captions show every line, so it works muted too.

steps.title: Movement assessment (13 tests)
steps.body: Direction tests, glute firing, hip rotation, core endurance. Skip anything painful — a skipped test is no data and never creates a finding.

steps.title: Posture check (band + bodyweight)
steps.body: Grades pelvis & core, hips (incl. duck feet), head & neck, upper back and shoulders. Honest grades beat heroic ones.

steps.title: Photo check with Muse
steps.body: Four standing photos. Send to Muse — it says whether the photos agree with your tests and what changed since last time.

steps.title: When to retest
steps.body: Every 4 weeks, every 2 while anything is Priority. Never on a flare day.

steps.title: Phases
steps.body: Reset (gentle range and breathing) → Control (own the position) → Strengthen (band strength) → Integrate (daily life). The weaker an area, the earlier its phase.

steps.title: One step at a time
steps.body: An area moves up at most one phase per retest. It can always move back.

steps.title: Stretching is built in
steps.body: Warm-ups move you through range; cool-downs hold the stretches for what you just trained.

steps.title: Reminders during work hours
steps.body: Turn on Desk reminders and pick your hours. Every 30–90 minutes you get a 1–2 minute break the coach runs.

steps.title: Add them to your calendar
steps.body: Web pages can't remind you when they're closed. Add to calendar puts the breaks on your phone.

steps.title: What to look at
steps.body: Pain trend (fixed 0–10 scale), consistency, and the progression gate: pain ≤ 3 on average and 8+ sessions in 14 days earns the next band level.

steps.title: Google Fit / Samsung Health
steps.body: Muse reads Health Connect and gives you one sync file. Import it under Progress → Health. It never changes your plan by itself.

steps.title: Stop rules
steps.body: Sharp, electric, leg or arm pain, or dizziness: stop that move. New numbness in the saddle area, leg weakness, or bladder/bowel changes: urgent care now.

steps.title: Flare days
steps.body: Pain 7 or more → relief work only. It's the plan working, not a day off.

steps.title: BackForge doesn't diagnose
steps.body: It screens patterns and trains. Show your findings to a physio.

steps.title: On this device
steps.body: Everything lives in this browser. Nothing is uploaded. Export a backup weekly.

steps.title: Encrypted photo vault
steps.body: Turn a photo set into encrypted files only your passphrase opens.

steps.title: Demo mode
steps.body: Want to see the app full of data? Preview with demo data — it's kept separate from yours.
